capability_queries.hyprland: protected policy.allow_hyprland_actions and session --hyprland on a routing broker; production takeover remains unavailable
capability_queries.lifetime: negotiated flags immutable within the owning fence; stop clears metadata
capability_queries.source: broker-negotiated registration flags and parent executor readiness; never inferred from Lua source
capability_queries.unavailable: current returns nil; has and ready return false
capability_queries.unknown_names: false; names must be strings of 1 to 128 bytes

custom_recognizers.context: fresh owning desktop without secure overlay
custom_recognizers.declaration_registry: Config.recognizers; canonical source-approved definitions persist without rules; runtime additions need no template and cannot add or alter definitions
custom_recognizers.device_catalog: independent declaration-scoped metadata without held state or ordinary input callbacks; ordinary resets when --input is also enabled
custom_recognizers.result: nil for pending or a strict phase/data table; cancellation returns nil
custom_recognizers.source: private canonical declaration, exact rule binding and complete approved snapshot parity

device_queries.catalog: permitted metadata received through input resets or declaration-scoped custom recognizer metadata; no host inventory scan
device_queries.delivery: ordinary --input resets, or independent --recognizers metadata without held state or ordinary input callbacks; current owning context and capabilities required
device_queries.empty_list: all known sources removed while context remains usable
device_queries.lookup: exact Source device/generation/seat with canonical decimal strings
device_queries.map_keys: numeric evdev type/axis keys in Lua
device_queries.nil: no received metadata, unknown source, missing mapping or unavailable/stale desktop context
device_queries.position: validated device counts to normalized/mm/output-local/global coordinates; no action authority
device_queries.seat: current fresh desktop binding/fence only; no other-seat enumeration

power.completion: accepted dispatch and observed compositor-reported DPMS state; no hardware power claim
power.deadline: remaining broker grant and 200ms total IPC budget
power.rule_output: explicit name or validated input mapping; no focus fallback
power.target: explicit frozen owning output, exact geometry generation and binding
power.uncertain: any failure after a mutating request may have been written; never retry

geometry_queries.context: fresh owning desktop without secure overlay
geometry_queries.conversion: finite numeric points, no clamping; arithmetic overflow raises an error
geometry_queries.local: post-transform logical units; rotation and scale applied through output logical size
geometry_queries.lookup: exact output name or rendered region ID
geometry_queries.normalized: post-transform output axes, not raw device axes
geometry_queries.overlaps: all matches in provider order, no target selection
geometry_queries.references: canonical decimal-string fence, snapshot revision and output geometry generation; copies confer no authority
geometry_queries.unavailable: nil for absent/stale/inhibited context, missing name or retired reference; known empty arrays remain empty

hyprland_adapter.completion: accepted dispatch plus observed target disappearance or exact workspace/output/focus
hyprland_adapter.deadline: remaining broker grant and 200ms total IPC budget
hyprland_adapter.race: stock address selectors cannot atomically test stableId; replacement after preflight can affect another window
hyprland_adapter.target: explicit frozen window address plus stableId, output, geometry generation and workspace; focus never selects a target
hyprland_adapter.uncertain: any failure after mutation bytes were written; never retry
hyprland_adapter.workspace_moves: adjacent positive numeric workspace on a single-output desktop

input_events.delivery: ordered, no coalescing; overflow retires the affected stream or Lua component
input_events.sources: explicit policy.allowed_devices selectors on the owning seat; virtual devices excluded

keyboard_context.independent: explicit global rules and explicit screen-off scopes need not infer keyboard state
keyboard_context.knowledge: OutputState.keyboard_known; false means unknown even without geometry
keyboard_context.native_annotations: inspection only until complete verified mapping and coverage
keyboard_context.unknown: KeyboardUnavailable for visibility conditions and awake spatial scopes

modules.runtime: approved sources only; no filesystem reads

morf_adapter.cancellation: known owning gesture only; no uncertain retry
morf_adapter.completion: native controller acceptance; no rendered animation/presentation proof
morf_adapter.production_gate: native rendered context and physical cutover
morf_adapter.transport: broker offer ID/ordinal and typed action only; no caller target, motion or deadline

morf_provider_queries.authority: read-only connection/configure metadata; no presentation, rendered regions, authentication, recognizer ownership or action grant
morf_provider_queries.identity: native Wayland socket credentials, exact executable/process, logind registration and bound compositor; connection epoch is independent of Lua configuration reload
morf_provider_queries.integers: compositor_start and fence identities are canonical decimal strings
morf_provider_queries.unavailable: nil without a fresh owning desktop; empty array when no native provider is currently verified

morf_rendered_queries.authority: inspection only; no input-mask, keyboard-absence, authentication, stacking or presentation proof
morf_rendered_queries.identity: verified native output/endpoint epoch, UI generation and broker fence
morf_rendered_queries.integers: node identity, UI generation, revision and sampled_ns are canonical decimal strings

keyboard_registry.absence: hidden applies only to the registered Morf node; does not set snapshot keyboard_known
keyboard_registry.known: one declared keyboard under the primary root, with node and layout

layout_projection.coordinates: global logical layout boxes; not animated rendered positions
layout_projection.identity: unique stable native producer PID, process birth, output, layer namespace/address/level/box and geometry generation
layout_projection.missing_bounds: viewport-clipped rows retain their native identities with null bounds

semantic.absence: does not establish hidden keyboard or complete coverage
semantic.coordinates: native frame bounds only; caller coordinates rejected
semantic.layout: required for keyboard only; 1 to 128 bytes without control characters

surface_space.local_scale: compositor logical units per native Morf layout unit

morf_rendered_queries.unavailable: nil without a fresh owning desktop; empty array when no fresh native frame is available

offline_replay.configuration: validated copy; no live rule or policy change
offline_replay.expectations: finish(true) requires matching final expected or expected_rules; unchecked replay never claims a passing test
offline_replay.failure: malformed records, engine errors and resource/expectation failures retire that replay; ordinary uncaught callback errors retire the VM
offline_replay.identities: outcome tables use canonical decimal strings for opaque identities and unsigned values above Lua's signed range; result.json preserves exact native CLI JSON
offline_replay.input: one native versioned recording JSON object per push
offline_replay.lifetime: owning VM generation; close/finish/error releases engine; no external handles

rule_hooks.budget: shared event subscription, fuel, time and log limits
rule_hooks.delivery: rule ID and phase filtered in the owning VM; registration order; updates may coalesce
rule_hooks.effects: observational; no returned effects, input claims or synthetic ownership
rule_hooks.lifetime: approved source generation; follows stable rule ID across acknowledged edits; removed rules emit no fresh matches; reload disposes the old VM
rule_hooks.registration: configuration only; rule ID must exist in the validated initial configuration

runtime_identities.comparison: exact string equality; no numeric conversion

runtime_layers.activation: fresh input only; existing candidates retired
runtime_layers.physical_toggles: preserved across runtime edits; reconciled on source reload
runtime_layers.queries: acknowledged definitions and activation overrides; no physical-key state

runtime_modes.activation: fresh input only; pending and active candidates retired
runtime_modes.authority: does not alter Observe/Route, policy or capability grants
runtime_modes.lifetime: owning seat registration; source reload restores declared initial selection
runtime_modes.queries: owned acknowledged definitions and active selection

service_inspection.configuration: acknowledged Rust model and canonical decimal-string rule revision; closures require original source
service_inspection.configuration_unavailable: nil when the acknowledged rule view has retired
service_inspection.phase: runtime callback or task; independent of desktop context
service_inspection.policy: protected permissions in that model; not negotiated execution grants

status.identity: current broker/configuration/session fence; revision and fence words are canonical decimal strings
status.pending: queued outgoing replies on the requesting agent connection; not global gestures or input ownership
status.state: broker-reported state, not native lock completion or authentication
status.timestamp: original broker packet time; never renewed by parent/helper delivery
status.transport: latest status accompanies bounded coalesced capability metadata without renewing either clock
status.unavailable: nil before a broker report, after expiry, on a different fence or at stop
